Tempest code FilterandTrim_Q20_Len200.R created seqtabs for each location-year, merged them, then removed chimeras and assigned taxonomy.


```{r phyloseq object Quality > 20 and Trunc to 200bp}

library(phyloseq)
seqtab = readRDS("~/phyloseq/ITS/seqtab.merged.NoC.RDS")
rownames(seqtab) <- gsub("hi", "HI", rownames(seqtab))

taxtab = readRDS("~/phyloseq/ITS/taxTab.RDS")
fieldData = readRDS("~/phyloseq/agData/fieldData_Combined.RDS")


# Merge Phyloseq
ps.its = phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab, taxa_are_rows = F), tax_table(taxtab), sample_data(fieldData))

# Add ASV short names
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(ps.its))
names(dna) <- taxa_names(ps.its)
ps.its <- merge_phyloseq(ps.its, dna)
taxa_names(ps.its) <- paste0("ASV", seq(ntaxa(ps.its)))


ps.its # 19,229 taxa
out.new = subset_taxa(ps.its, Kingdom == "k__Fungi" & !is.na(Kingdom))
summary(refseq(out.new)@ranges@width) # All 200bp 
m_fungi = as.data.frame(tax_table(out.new))
nrow(m_fungi) # 17,008 Fungi ASVs
nrow(m_fungi[!is.na(m_fungi$Genus),]) # 13,833 fungi ASVs @ Genus
length(unique(m_fungi$Genus)) # 1,511 unique fungi genera

ps.its
saveRDS(ps.its, "~/phyloseq/ITS/ps.q20.trunc200.RDS")
```
